title: Net quantity of the commodity
requirement: The package must state the net quantity of the commodity it contains, in terms of the standard unit of weight or measure. Where the commodity is packed or sold by number, the package must state the number of the commodity it contains.
legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(c) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
